descriptions.w3d_d26e_tile_16_to_565_b_801d7e20: Second copy of the 16-bit to RGB565 tile conversion at 0x801d7c94, with identical instructions: converts the block at (ox, oy) into one big-endian RGB565 4x4 tile with 8-byte rows. Why two copies exist is not known; they may be two format entries of one converter table.
